originalTitle: South Korea’s KOSPI halts trade after 8% wipeout on AI losses
summary: Investing.com-- South Korea’s KOSPI stock index plummeted 8% at the open on Friday, triggering a 20 minute trading halt as markets grappled with a prolonged, deepening rout in artificial intelligence stocks.
content:
Investing.com-- South Korea's KOSPI stock index plummeted 8% at the open on Friday, triggering a 20 minute trading halt as markets grappled with a prolonged, deepening rout in artificial intelligence stocks.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

The KOSPI opened down 8.55% at 4,923.47 points, immediately triggering a 20-minute trading halt. It marked the tenth time this year that South Korea's bourse operator activated a circuit breaker for local markets.

Friday's losses put the KOSPI at a nine-month low, with the index slated to wipe out over 19% from an intraday peak hit in late-October. It has now wiped out nearly 48% from a record high hit in June.

The index was battered chiefly by a prolonged rout in chipmaking and AI-exposed names, which slumped tracking an overnight wipeout on Wall Street.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slumped 12.3%, while the NASDAQ Composite tumbled 5.5% in its worst session since April 2025.

Tech was battered by growing fears of increased regulatory scrutiny towards AI and data center construction in the U.S., after the Democrats won majorities in both chambers of Congress this week.

Memory chip giant Samsung Electronics Co Ltd (KS:005930) tumbled 10%, while rival SK Hynix Inc (KS:000660) slid 11.7%. The two were by far the biggest driver of the KOSPI's AI-driven rally this year, and were the worst hit by unwinding tech valuations.

The two are major suppliers to the AI buildout, and are exposed to any potential slowdown in construction. Samsung and SK Hynix are also subject to heavily leveraged bets on the long-term AI trade, through several Korean exchange-traded funds, which now appeared to be coming apart.

chineseTitle: 韩国 KOSPI 因 AI 损失下跌 8% 后暂停交易
chineseSummary: Investing.com——韩国 KOSPI 股指周五开盘暴跌 8%，引发 20 分钟交易暂停，市场正努力应对人工智能股票长期、不断加深的暴跌。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——韩国 KOSPI 股指周五开盘暴跌 8%，引发 20 分钟交易暂停，市场正努力应对人工智能股长期、不断加深的溃败。

KOSPI 开盘下跌 8.55%，报 4,923.47 点，随即触发 20 分钟停牌。这是韩国交易所运营商今年第十次启动本地市场熔断机制。

周五的下跌使 KOSPI 跌至 9 个月以来的最低点，该指数预计较 10 月底触及的盘中峰值下跌超过 19%。目前，该股已较 6 月份创下的历史新高下跌近 48%。

该指数受到的打击主要是芯片制造和人工智能相关企业的长期溃败，随着华尔街隔夜的暴跌，该指数也大幅下跌。

费城半导体指数下跌 12.3%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 5.5%，创 2025 年 4 月以来最糟糕交易日。

民主党本周在国会两院赢得多数席位后，人们越来越担心美国对人工智能和数据中心建设的监管审查力度加大，科技股受到重创。

存储芯片巨头三星电子有限公司 (KS:005930) 下跌 10%，而竞争对手 SK 海力士公司 (KS:000660) 下跌 11.7%。迄今为止，这两家公司是今年人工智能驱动的韩国综合股价指数上涨的最大推动力，也是受科技股估值下跌影响最严重的。

这两家公司是人工智能建设的主要供应商，并且面临着任何潜在的建设放缓的风险。三星和 SK 海力士还通过几家韩国交易所交易基金对长期人工智能贸易进行了高杠杆押注，但这些基金现在似乎正在分崩离析。
